title: AI Pentesting Checklist for Web Apps: 15 Questions to Ask Before Choosing a Vendor
content_md: TL;DR Attackers move first. On average, exploitation now starts before a patch exists (Mandiant M-Trends 2026). In 1H 2026, 23% of vulnerabilities VulnCheck added to its exploited list were hit on or before disclosure day. AI pentesting vendors aren't interchangeable. Most look convincing in a demo.
